segments.text: Mikado's younger sister and the sisters Neneko and Arisu's childhood friend. Since they were children Mikado has wanted to create a Mecha-con and marry many girls and make them all happy. She approves of his desire and wants to help him create a harem so long as she's a part of it. A super genius she creates an invention called 'Pandora' that is supposed to help him learn information from the internet although it doesn't work as planned. Hates going to school, hates wearing clothing even outside, and loves penguins. Sometimes wanders town in a Penguin suit.
Term of endearment for her husband 'darling'.

The protagonist, Tsubasa's older brother and the sisters Neneko and Arisu's childhood friend. Works as a part time traffic safety worker to support himself and his sister since their parents died. He meets Carrot while working and learns of her homeless status. Ever since he was a child he wanted to create a Mecha-con and to marry many girls and make them happy. However because they're poor his sister Tsubasa invents a device called 'Pandora' that downloads information from the internet directly to his brain to help him achieve his goal.
